advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that drives a gate_dispatch boundary (e.g. dispatch_plan_review / _run_verify_completion) and asserts the config resolved through with_identity carries the run span's trace id, so a reordering of the `with (...)` tuple turns the test red.
evidence: gate_dispatch.py:171 `run_span("review-plan", ticket_id=ctx.ticket_id),` — the actual load-bearing tuple ordering under review
gate_dispatch.py:715-718 `# run_span FIRST: it must ENCLOSE the gate_config(with_identity(...)) statement ... run_span("verify-completion", ticket_id=ticket_id),`
test_run_span.py:95-97 `with run_span("review-plan", ticket_id="t"): got = mint_run_identity(...)` — reproduces the ordering in the test itself rather than invoking the gate_dispatch statement

ABSENCE: search_files for `run_span` shows no test references dispatch_plan_review, _run_verify_completion, or produce_code_review_verdict; no test drives the gate_dispatch `with (...)` argument-evaluation ordering the commit calls 'load-bearing'
advisory.finding: No test exercises the load-bearing context-manager ordering in gate_dispatch.py that the diff introduces. The commit message and test docstring (test_run_span_makes_identity_read_it) claim a held-out test fails if run_span is opened inside rather than around the `gate_config(with_identity(...))` statement, but every test manually calls mint_run_identity inside a bare `with run_span(...)` body and never drives dispatch_plan_review / _run_verify_completion / produce_code_review_verdict. Reordering the gate_dispatch tuple (span no longer current when the with_identity(...) argument is evaluated) would silently defeat the change without any test turning red.
scenarios: A refactor reorders the gate_dispatch `with (...)` tuple so run_span no longer precedes gate_config(with_identity(...)); mint_run_identity mints a fresh id and the run fans out into many traces again, but all tests stay green
advisory.suggested_fix: Invoke the real gate_dispatch entrypoint (or a thin harness around its `with (...)` statement) with a stubbed tracer and assert the LLMConfig.trace_id seen inside the run equals the span's trace id; verify the test fails if run_span is moved after gate_config(with_identity(...)).
